frontmatter.name: llms-deep-optimizer
frontmatter.description: Audit and repair llms indexes, facts, full/small catalogues and families through evidence- based convergence: shape, links, descriptions, source fidelity, privacy and available retrieval/agent probes. Also builds topical files from graded fact pools. TRIGGER: "optimize this llms.txt", "check the facts file", "fix the llms family", "/ldo", "build a topical llms file from this pool". SKIP: SKILL.md or hub-spoke instructions → skill-optimizer; new notes conversion → notes-to-llms; a new family from a site/repo → crawl-to-llms-txt; prompts → prompt-deep-optimizer; prose critique → writing-expert (references/document-critique.md); SQL → deep-query-optimizer; raw crawling → web-text-mirror.

check the facts file against the source mirror
build a topical llms file from this graded fact pool
